prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: decision-tree-dissection
TEACHING PURPOSE: Expose exactly what the frozen expression checks and returns.
CAMERA: Straight-on technical macro with a low horizontal horizon.
An exquisite disassembled mechanical selector on a dark graphite workbench, brushed aluminum, smoked glass and a single warm work light. The selector hardware occupies the BOTTOM RIGHT corner, only the outer fourth of the frame. The LEFT and UPPER THREE QUARTERS are clean almost-black graphite, subtly textured, for a precise SVG decision tree. No actual circuit, wire routes, labels, symbols, outputs or screens. The hardware is a restrained conceptual embellishment, not an operating security device.
COMPOSITING INTENT: A vertical input-to-name-test spine opens into two widely separated branches. Match and other-name results are revealed as quoted strings; RETURNED LABEL ONLY has equal scale.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: FROZEN RULE / LOCAL EVALUATION. Here is one frozen SideFX decision expression. For an adjudicate request, it compares the tool name with dangerous tool. A match returns operator required. Any other name returns allow. These are returned labels. Neither label, by itself, stops a command.
